jobs.description: The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium. The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration. The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance. As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. This role represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of protection, retirement security, health, and financial well-being for millions of military members, veterans, and their families. At USAA, our mission is to empower more than 14 million members to achieve financial security through competitive products, exceptional service, and trusted advice. For more than a century, USAA has earned the trust of the military community by helping members navigate life's most important financial decisions. Today, the Life Company business sits at the center of that mission, delivering a broad portfolio of life insurance, annuity, health, Medicare, and supplemental protection solutions designed to help members protect their families, prepare for the unexpected, accumulate assets, generate retirement income, and build long-term financial security. This is not a traditional product marketing role. It is a business leadership opportunity. The executive selected for this role will help define how USAA brings its Life, Annuity, and Health solutions to market, driving growth across one of the company's most important businesses. The successful candidate will build upon the trust, loyalty, and brand equity that make USAA one of the most respected financial institutions in the country while helping modernize and evolve how members discover, evaluate, purchase, and engage with protection, health, and retirement solutions in an increasingly digital world. Equally important, this executive will have the opportunity to work alongside a transformational marketing leader known for building high-performing teams, modernizing marketing organizations, and driving growth across some of the most respected brands in financial services. Candidates who are energized by building, innovating, and creating lasting enterprise value will find a leadership environment built on collaboration, accountability, and impact. It is an opportunity to influence how millions of military families protect what matters most, prepare for retirement, navigate healthcare needs, and achieve greater financial security at every stage of life.
